How to play

Play together on one phone.

  1. Enter your names. You each start with one card.
  2. Tap the centre deck to turn over a card.
  3. Find the same picture on your card and the centre card.
  4. Say the word in English, then tap your “Take card” button. The first player to tap wins the centre card.
  5. Your new card goes on top of your pile. Tap the centre deck to turn over the next card.
  6. Keep playing until the centre deck is empty. The player with the most cards wins!

Need a hint?

Press and hold a picture to see the word. Let go to hide it.

Tapped by mistake?

Tap “Undo” to cancel the last move.
